question: Do the new temporary-root-default checks each die on their own assertion, or on one shared one?
method: Applied each mutation as an uncommitted edit on top of the committed fix (commit 61b7e00), ran 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-temporary-root.ps1', recorded exit code and the first thrown message, then reverted with 'git checkout -- scripts/TemporaryRoot.ps1' (confirmed clean via 'git status --short') before applying the next one.

A.find:
return [pscustomobject]@{
        Path = (Get-OwnVerificationTemporaryRoot -RepositoryRoot $RepositoryRoot -Suffix $OwnDirectorySuffix)
        Source = "own run directory"
        # Only this tier's directory is this run's alone to create and
        # destroy. An explicit -TemporaryRoot or $env:DUNGEON_FORTRESS_TEMP
        # names a directory the caller chose and may be reusing on purpose
        # (evidence/302-temp-contention.json's own workarounds did exactly
        # that across retries), so this run never deletes it.
        Owned = $true
    }
}
A.caughtBy: the resolution-order block's own-directory check in test-temporary-root.ps1 (Source must not be 'TMP/TEMP')
A.result: red, exit 1. First thrown message: "Without -TemporaryRoot or $env:DUNGEON_FORTRESS_TEMP, resolution fell back to the ambient TMP/TEMP - the Issue #302 defect: this machine's TMP/TEMP is a directory this account cannot delete from (evidence/302-temp-contention.json), and a shared machine directory is exactly what two concurrent agents collide on."

B.caughtBy: the Complete-VerificationTemporaryRoot check in test-temporary-root.ps1 (an owned directory must be gone afterward)
B.result: red, exit 1. First thrown message: "Complete-VerificationTemporaryRoot left an owned directory behind ('C:\\gamedev\\_wt-302\\.artifacts\\temporary-root-test-5274297769d9425588e375dc5ad23c94\\owned-cleanup-3af590a479e544908b300c0cf9e82b9e'); a run that owns its temporary root has to remove it (Issue #302)."

C.find:
$selection = Resolve-VerificationTemporaryRoot -ExplicitPath $ExplicitPath -RepositoryRoot $RepositoryRoot -OwnDirectorySuffix $OwnDirectorySuffix
    $candidate = ConvertTo-NormalizedRootPath -Path $selection.Path
    # Unconditional, on purpose: the own-directory default is not exempt from
    # this. It goes through the exact same probe - create, write, delete - as
    # an explicit -TemporaryRoot always has, so a default that lands on an
    # unusable directory (a file already there, a parent it cannot write to)
    # is still refused by name and reason in preflight rather than accepted
    # because this run picked it itself (Issue #302, mutant C).
    $diagnosis = Get-TemporaryRootDiagnosis -Path $candidate
    if ($null -ne $diagnosis) {
C.caughtBy: the planted-conflict check in test-temporary-root.ps1 (a file at the predicted own-directory path must still be refused)
C.result: red, exit 1. First thrown message: "The own-directory default was accepted even though 'C:\\gamedev\\df-verify-conflict-423030c8' is a file, not a directory - the usual diagnosis did not run against it."

mutants.conclusion: Each of A, B and C is caught by a distinct assertion with a distinct message, none of them the same check. Working tree confirmed clean ('git status --short' showed only the untracked evidence-tmp/ scratch directory) after every revert.
